name: MINT
description: MINT is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to solve tasks through multi-turn interactions involving tool use and natural language feedback. It repurposes diverse established datasets focusing on reasoning, coding, and decision-making, providing an evaluation framework where LLMs can execute Python code and receive simulated user feedback.
reputation: A recent benchmark used in research on tool-using and interactive LLM agents, but it is not yet as broadly adopted as major static reasoning benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on multi-turn interactions with tools and language feedback; uses GPT-4 to simulate user feedback; repurposes existing datasets into a compact subset.
